description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles errors related to invalid namespaced entity IDs, providing builder methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about the exception.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException
classes.description: A runtime exception thrown when a namespaced entity ID is invalid, extending DittoRuntimeException and providing additional context and JSON parsing capabilities.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException with flexible parameters.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON fields used in serialization/deserialization of the exception.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception, with optional entity ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the exception, if available.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with new headers.
